title: La Jimadora de Arandas, VISTA STORIES
comment: jima-arandas (VISTA): campo de agave azul de una hacienda tequilera en Arandas, Jalisco. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.GRACIELA_OLMOS: Mexican woman, matriarch and owner of a tequila hacienda, 64 years old, fair skin, grey hair pulled back in a tight low bun, a stern face, a black long-sleeve silk blouse, a burgundy rebozo over her shoulders, a single strand of pearls, a long dark-grey skirt, black flat shoes, her hands empty.
chars.SANTIAGO_OLMOS: Mexican man, heir of the tequila hacienda, 34 years old, light skin, short brown hair, a short trimmed beard, a white linen long-sleeve shirt with rolled sleeves, beige trousers, brown leather boots, a light straw hat, his hands empty.
chars.MARISOL_OLMOS: Mexican woman, agave harvester (jimadora), 28 years old, warm brown skin, long black hair in a single thick braid, strong expressive dark eyes, a worn wide straw hat, a faded light-blue denim long-sleeve shirt, a red bandana around her neck, brown work trousers, dusty work boots, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_AGAVEARANDAS: Blue agave field of an old tequila hacienda in the highlands of Arandas, Jalisco, in the morning: long straight rows of blue-grey agave plants on red earth, a few freshly harvested agave hearts on the ground, the white hacienda house with a bell tower far in the background, soft morning light and a clear sky, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
